questions.qtext: Absorptivity of a body is equal to its emissivity according to Kirchoff’s law:
questions.solution:
(a, c)
Kirchoff’s Law: The emissivity(ε) and absorptivity (α) of a real surface are equal for radiation
with identical temperature and wavelength.
